    """
    Reject negative n with ValueError. For nonnegative n return n + 1 if
    enabled and n >= 2; otherwise return n.
    
    >>> bonus(3)
    4
    """
    if n < 0:
        raise ValueError("negative")
    if enabled and n >= 2:
        return n + 1
    return n
